races.name: Debenhams Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Cuff It
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced unknown quantity from the Spencer yard who could have any amount of improvement in the locker.

runners_data.name: I Got Rhythm
runners_data.note: Another unexposed runner whose true ability remains unclear, making them dangerous in this novice company.

runners_data.name: Quartermaster
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 155 days off but showed class when winning last time at Lingfield.

runners_data.name: Tales Of Wisdom
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who loves to bowl along but disappointed when stepped up to 7f last time.

runners_data.name: Bayaann
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from a long layoff of 176 days, which is a significant concern for fitness.

runners_data.name: Bemersyde
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in good recent form with apprentice jockey Moldoveanu taking off 7lbs.

runners_data.name: Queen's Companion
runners_data.note: Front-running type returning from 202 days off, making fitness a question mark despite the leading style suiting.

runners_data.name: King Cherry
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing a tongue-tie for the first time, suggesting connections are looking for improvement.

runners_data.name: Anthena
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up performer whose recent form figures of 9-7 suggest limited ability.

runners_data.name: Me An' All
runners_data.note: Another weak hold-up horse whose form figures of 96 indicate they're outclassed in this company.

races.paceDynamic: Tales Of Wisdom and Queen's Companion are the two confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead in this novice affair. With only two pace-setters in a 10-runner field, they're likely to set a manageable gallop rather than burn each other out. The majority of the field comprises hold-up horses (Quartermaster, Bayaann, Bemersyde, King Cherry, Anthena, Me An' All) who will be relying on the front pair to provide something to aim at. This race shape strongly favours the front-runners and prominent racers, as the lack of pace pressure should allow them to dictate terms and prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tales Of Wisdom and Queen's Companion settle into a comfortable rhythm without killing each other.
scenarios.body: The manageable early pace allows one or both pace-setters to kick clear in the straight, with the hold-up brigade arriving too late. This perfectly suits the natural front-running styles of both leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the front pair go too steady and create a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace results in a bunched field turning for home, allowing the superior class of Quartermaster or unknown quantities to produce telling late kicks. Hold-up horses get their ideal scenario of a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unknown quantities settles just behind the leaders.
scenarios.body: Cuff It or I Got Rhythm travel smoothly in behind the front pair before striking at the perfect moment when the leaders tire. Their unknown ability gives them the edge over the exposed hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Hold-Up Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the furlong pole, allowing a well-handicapped hold-up horse like Bemersyde to produce a devastating late burst. This requires the front pair to go suicidally slow.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Tales Of Wisdom and Queen's Companion engage in an early speed duel rather than settling, as this would compromise both front-runners.
Monitor the market moves on Cuff It and I Got Rhythm, as any significant support could indicate hidden ability from these lightly-raced runners.
Check if Quartermaster shows early signs of ring-rustiness given the 155-day layoff, which could blunt their late kick.
Observe if Queen's Companion travels kindly early despite the 202-day absence, as fitness concerns could see them fold despite the tactical advantage.
Watch for Bemersyde to be produced with a well-timed run given the 7lb apprentice allowance and recent form upturn.

races.name: Boodles Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Asgard's Captain
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent form who should get ideal tracking position behind the pace battle

runners_data.name: Pride Of Donegal
runners_data.note: Front-runner with visor fitted but faces three other pace rivals in small field

runners_data.name: Arqoob
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 167-day break but Lucy Wadham's 50% strike rate with returnees is encouraging

runners_data.name: Marnier
runners_data.note: Leader who may struggle to dominate pace against three other front-runners despite Gosden training

runners_data.name: Ernst Blofeld
runners_data.note: Prominent runner off long 288-day absence for trainer with no winners from nine recent attempts

runners_data.name: Master Vintner
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 188-day break but has won twice fresh and Ralph Beckett excels with returnees

runners_data.name: Topteam
runners_data.note: Consistent front-runner with strong recent form and Oisin Murphy booking suggests confidence

runners_data.name: Double Meaning
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with significant 13lb weight advantage but concerning 198-day layoff for low-strike-rate trainer

races.paceDynamic: Pride Of Donegal, Marnier, Master Vintner and Topteam will create a fierce early gallop with four confirmed front-runners all wanting to lead this small field. The pace will be genuinely strong throughout with limited respite, particularly demanding over this stamina-sapping 1m4f trip at Newmarket. This relentless gallop will set up the race perfectly for hold-up horses like Arqoob who can pick up the pieces late, while the prominent runners Asgard's Captain and Ernst Blofeld may find the perfect stalking position. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up artists and closers who can benefit from the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners go too hard early and crack in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field and allow late runners to sweep past tiring leaders in the closing stages. Arqoob's hold-up style becomes the winning formula as stamina tells.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the stalkers can find the perfect position behind the pace battle
scenarios.body: Asgard's Captain or Ernst Blofeld can track the leaders without getting embroiled in the early speed duel. They strike at the optimal moment when the pace begins to tell but before the closers arrive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Topteam or Master Vintner can dictate more sensible fractions despite the competition
scenarios.body: One of the classier leaders manages the pace battle intelligently and has enough left to resist late challenges. Their recent form and higher ratings prove decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners completely cancel each other out in a suicidal pace war
scenarios.body: The four leaders engage in such fierce early combat that they all fade dramatically, leaving the race to be won by whatever horse can best pick up the pieces. Double Meaning's low weight becomes a crucial advantage.

watchPoints.text: Multiple front-runners Pride Of Donegal, Marnier, Master Vintner and Topteam could create unsustainably fast early pace
Arqoob returning after 167 days off but trainer Lucy Wadham has excellent record with horses coming back from breaks
Ernst Blofeld and Master Vintner both face fitness questions after lengthy absences exceeding six months
Double Meaning carries just 122lbs, giving him a stone advantage over the top-weights in this competitive handicap
Topteam has Oisin Murphy riding and strong recent form suggesting he can handle the expected pace pressure

runners_data.name: Blue Samuna

runners_data.name: India Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 147-day layoff, long absence is major concern despite previous ability

runners_data.name: Tardaff
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 262-day break, extreme layoff makes her hard to recommend

runners_data.name: Borderline Madness
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent win, low weight and William Stone's perfect 14-day record notable

runners_data.name: Case Study

runners_data.name: Wild Rosie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with headgear retained, consistent recent efforts but lacks a winning profile

races.paceDynamic: Blue Samuna is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate a steady, uncontested early pace given her lack of competition for the lead. The prominent racers Crazee Icon, Tamzan, Safe Harbor and Daretobedifferent will track behind in the second rank, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Dream Illusion, Bearin Up, Khuskhas and Borderline Madness will be held off the pace. With minimal early pressure on Blue Samuna, this sets up perfectly for horses that can travel smoothly in behind and produce late kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and strong-finishing hold-up horses who can benefit from the sedate early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Kick Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and Blue Samuna isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect tempo to unleash telling late runs, with the front half struggling to sustain their effort. Dream Illusion and Bearin Up are ideally positioned to capitalise on their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Crazee Icon or Tamzan apply early pressure to Blue Samuna and quicken the tempo
scenarios.body: The increased pace suits the well-positioned prominent racers who can track the speed without overexerting. Crazee Icon's class and Tamzan's consistent form make them the primary beneficiaries of this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Blue Samuna Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Samuna maintains her lead unchallenged and finds extra stamina at 1m
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader capitalises on soft fractions to stay on strongly, with her recent 8f runs suggesting stamina potential. Blue Samuna holds off the late challengers who leave their run too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Creates Opportunity
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint finish with multiple horses converging
scenarios.body: The tactical battle becomes messy with several hold-up horses arriving simultaneously, favouring those with the best turn of foot. Fresher horses like Borderline Madness and improving types like Safe Harbor can capitalise on the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Blue Samuna could steal this if she gets completely uncontested fractions and the field leaves it too late to reel her in
Dream Illusion carries top weight at 142lbs which could blunt her finishing kick despite her hold-up style suiting the pace
India Gold and Tardaff face serious fitness questions after layoffs of 147 and 262 days respectively
Crazee Icon's position tracking Blue Samuna will be crucial as she needs to avoid getting trapped behind a slow pace
The large group of hold-up horses could cause traffic problems in the straight if they all arrive together

runners_data.name: Caph Star

runners_data.name: Expressionless
runners_data.note: Back in trip after disappointing over 2m last time, apprentice Lewis takes off useful weight and horse has winning form over this distance

runners_data.name: Beach Point
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who needs strong pace to be effective, consistent place form suggests solid each-way claims with Murphy aboard

runners_data.name: Salaria
runners_data.note: Young hold-up performer stepping up in class, trainer Clover sending limited team but horse showed promise when winning at Kempton

runners_data.name: Caledonian
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who struggled in last two starts, needs to bounce back to earlier form but has winning ability at this level

runners_data.name: Sansanetti
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long break with big weight advantage, has course form and could exploit the tactical scenario

races.paceDynamic: Sir Edward Lear and Sansanetti are the only two horses with prominent/leading tendencies in a field dominated by hold-up performers. With Sir Edward Lear likely to take them along at a sustainable gallop, the pace will be steady rather than fierce early on. The six hold-up horses (A Major Payne, Caph Star, Expressionless, Beach Point, Salaria, Caledonian) will be bunched behind waiting for their chance. This setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to the pace and kick from the front, as the hold-up brigade will face a traffic-laden sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Edward Lear and Sansanetti dictate terms without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The modest early pace allows them to conserve energy while the hold-up horses get trapped behind. When the kick comes, those already positioned have first run on their rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get a perfect setup with all coming wide and late in a cavalry charge finish. Superior class and finishing speed determine the outcome.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent creates interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get hampered or blocked as six runners try to launch simultaneously from the back. The unimpeded front runners capitalise on the confusion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Perfectly Run Race
scenarios.trigger: If pace is ideal and all get clear runs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure ability test where ratings and current form decide the outcome. The highest-rated in-form horses prevail regardless of tactics.

watchPoints.text: Sir Edward Lear breaking slowly from the stalls given his 225-day layoff could leave Sansanetti as the sole pace angle
A Major Payne and Caph Star both switching off properly in the early stages as both can be keen and waste energy
The hold-up sextet bunching too tightly turning for home, creating inevitable traffic problems in the straight
Expressionless getting too far back early as the 5lb apprentice may struggle to position this hold-up horse effectively
Beach Point and Salaria finding racing room when the pace quickens, as both need clear runs to show their best

races.name: Behind The Bridle Racehorse Aftercare Handicap

runners_data.name: We're Goosers
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Oisin Murphy aboard and highest rating, but form has dipped since July with concerning last-time-out effort.

runners_data.name: Gizmo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 229-day break for Michael Bell, but showed clear ability when winning at this trip on debut.

runners_data.name: Just A Girl
runners_data.note: Front runner with solid 7f form but carried penalty burden recently and faces stronger opposition than recent wins.

runners_data.name: Deluded
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from Charlie Fellowes stable in good form, lowest weight advantage could prove crucial in tight finish.

runners_data.name: Magic Box
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner for William Haggas returning after 225-day absence, previous 7f form suggests competitiveness despite long break.

runners_data.name: Wield
runners_data.note: Front runner from small Joseph Parr yard with apprentice Morris, recent form suggests struggle to lead throughout against this quality.

races.paceDynamic: Just A Girl and Wield will contest the early lead in this small field, with Just A Girl showing more consistent front-running form and likely to dictate terms. The pace should be honest rather than frantic given only two confirmed leaders, allowing the quartet of hold-up horses (Gizmo, Deluded, Magic Box) to close from off the pace. We're Goosers sits as the sole prominent runner behind the leaders, potentially finding himself in a perfect stalking position. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners and patient hold-up horses who can finish, with the front-runners vulnerable to being picked off.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Girl and Wield duel early and weaken
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuine enough to set up the closers, with Gizmo and Deluded having the class and tactical advantage to sweep past tired leaders. The 7f trip on good ground suits patient tactics perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner strikes
scenarios.trigger: If We're Goosers positions perfectly behind the pace
scenarios.body: Murphy can track the leaders without getting embroiled in early speed, then strike when the front pair tire. His superior rating and tactical position prove decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Girl gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: With Wield failing to engage seriously, Just A Girl controls the tempo and has enough left to hold the closers. Her proven 7f form and front-running ability shine through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole, suiting the highest-rated horse with tactical speed. We're Goosers and any closer with a turn of foot benefit from the lack of early pace.

watchPoints.text: Just A Girl and Wield engagement levels early - if one gets uncontested lead, the race dynamics change completely
Gizmo showing market support despite long layoff - any confidence suggests readiness to perform fresh
We're Goosers positioning behind leaders - Murphy's tactical ride crucial given recent form concerns
Magic Box response to pressure after long break - Haggas runners often need time but she has 7f form
Deluded getting clear run in finish - hold-up horses need luck in running with small field spread

races.name: Horse Comes First Handicap

runners_data.name: Nebulon

runners_data.name: Southern Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly suited to this strong pace scenario, though Liam Wright's 5lb claim raises questions.

runners_data.name: King Of Chaos

runners_data.comment: 1-9 but he ran respectably at Catterick last time on his first start since being gelded
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from nine starts came when making all in a four-runner maiden at Hamilton (6f) last August when trained by Karl Burke; ran respectably at Catterick (5f, good) three weeks ago on his first start since being gelded and he can come on from that first outing since January.

runners_data.name: Akabusi

runners_data.name: Daizen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from Rebecca Menzies who boasts strong 14-day figures (3/20) and good recent form.

runners_data.name: Quantum Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse suited by the pace but 7lb claimer Molly Keegan-Price may struggle in competitive handicap.

runners_data.name: Logi Bear

runners_data.name: Angels' Share
runners_data.note: Non-runner status confirmed, removing one key pace angle from the contest.

races.paceDynamic: Angels' Share, Victor Cee and Akabusi are three confirmed front runners who will clash from the gate in this 6f handicap, creating a strong early gallop. Victor Cee has shown ability to make all when winning at Hamilton, while Angels' Share has won twice at 7f when leading, suggesting neither will yield easily. The sustained pace from flag to finish will stretch stamina reserves over this stiff 6f at Newmarket. This aggressive early tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy and finish, with prominent runners also well-placed to capitalize if the leaders tie up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Burn Out
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners engage in a pace duel from the start
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will drain Angels' Share, Victor Cee and Akabusi, setting up a finish for the closers who travel kindly behind the pace. Hold-up horses like Southern Warrior, King Of Chaos and Ecclefechan can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets a soft lead while the others pressure each other
scenarios.body: The winner will come from those tracking in second or third position, able to strike when the leader weakens but avoiding the late traffic. Nebulon and Daizen are best positioned to exploit this scenario from their prominent styles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Angels' Share or Victor Cee can steal a march and get first run
scenarios.body: The class leader breaks clear before the closers can organize their challenge, maintaining enough to hold off late charges. Angels' Share's higher rating and proven front-running ability at 7f suggests stamina to see out this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders check each other's speed in the opening two furlongs
scenarios.body: A falsely run race becomes a sprint where natural speed matters most, negating the hold-up horses' tactical advantage. This unlikely scenario would favor horses with early pace who can quicken.

watchPoints.text: Angels' Share is listed as a non-runner which removes a key front runner and changes the entire pace dynamic.
Victor Cee and Akabusi must be watched for early pace pressure as the two remaining confirmed leaders will clash immediately.
Southern Warrior's 5lb claiming jockey Liam Wright needs monitoring in what could be a tactical finish requiring experience.
Oisin Murphy's booking for Ecclefechan suggests stable confidence in a hold-up horse perfectly suited to this pace setup.
Daizen's prominent style could be crucial if he can secure the ideal tracking position behind the battling front runners.
